title: On-foot HUD: exposure, inventory, interaction line
description: The surface-mode HUD: the exposure/radiation meter, the inventory weight bar, and the unified interaction prompt line — the on-foot counterpart of the ship HUD.
acceptanceCriteria: Exposure meter (bottom-right, above the weight bar): a vertical bar (50 max) that fills as exposure is lost (TASK-48); green > 25, amber 10-25, red < 10; a radiation icon when in a rad zone, a storm icon in a storm; a 'RECOVERING' state (bar frozen, pulsing red, 5 s countdown) when knocked down
Weight bar (bottom-right): the TASK-34 weight bar (weightUsed/40, amber near cap, red at cap) with the item counts on hover ('iron x12, crystal x2'); updates at 10 Hz

Interaction line (bottom-center): the single prompt line for all on-foot actions (TASK-33): '[E] Take iron x3' / '[E] Enter ship' / '[E] Dock terminal' / '[E] Mine (hold)' with the mining radial progress (TASK-38) drawn around it; one prompt at a time (nearest wins); hidden when nothing is in range

Mode coherence: when on foot, the ship HUD's flight readouts (speed/altitude/nav) are hidden and the on-foot elements show — and vice versa when in the ship; the switch happens at the regime change frame (no lingering elements, no overlap with the camera handoff, TASK-27)
Performance: on-foot HUD work < 0.5 ms/frame (snapshot-driven; the only rAF work is the mining radial, a conic-gradient angle write)

Unit/component tests: exposure bar states (exact thresholds), recovering countdown (fake timers), weight bar formatting, prompt line exclusivity (two targets in range → only the nearest shows), mode switch (no element from the other mode renders after the switch); e2e: on-foot HUD screenshot (exposure meter visible in a rad zone)

steps.details: ExposureMeter: from the player's hazard state (snapshot field exposure, recoveringUntil — extend the snapshot's player state in this task, small protocol addition); icon by active hazard kind (the snapshot includes the current hazard id when inside one).

WeightBar (TASK-34, moved into the on-foot HUD slot with hover counts); InteractionLine: the unified prompt (the TASK-33 prompt is already single — this task gives it its final layout + the mining radial (a conic-gradient ring, rAF angle write from the server's miningProgress).

HUD mode = the player's activeEntity kind (ship/character) — a single source of truth; the HUD root renders the ShipHUD or OnFootHUD subtree (never both); the switch is atomic with the camera handoff (same event).
All listed; e2e rad-zone screenshot. Run full suite + e2e.

technicalNotes: The snapshot player-state extension (exposure, hazard id) is the only protocol change — keep it in the existing entity_update envelope.
One HUD mode at a time is a hard rule — the mode-switch test enforces it.
